name: Wavetable Diatonic Chord
author: Tom Burns
description: Diatonic chords over Braids Renaissance's WTCH scan, with independent voice spread and wavetable position. From Tom Burns' Braids Renaissance firmware.

controls.label: Chord
controls.description: Steps through the same sixteen scale-degree chord shapes as Diatonic Chord.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Spreads the voices symmetrically, independent of the selected table position.

controls.label: Scale
controls.description: Selects the scale the chord is built from, which decides its quality.

outputs.main: Wavetable chord; the stereo toggle does not change this fixed MAIN/AUX pair.
outputs.aux: Root voice; the stereo toggle does not change this fixed MAIN/AUX pair.

trigger: Realigns every voice so a struck chord starts the same way each time.
